sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Load the compiled bundle from a CDN, install the package, or import the source from a bundler.

snippets.code:
# Install the framework and the Sass compiler used by the source build
npm install bootstrap@5.3.3
npm install --save-dev sass

# Copy the compiled files when the app serves static assets directly
mkdir -p public/vendor
cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css public/vendor/
cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js public/vendor/

<!-- The bundle already contains Popper, so dropdowns, tooltips and modals work -->
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js" defer></script>
